functions.name: cl_debug
functions.signature: extern void cl_debug(void);
functions.description: Enable global libclamav debug messages. Call before going multithreaded so all threads inherit debug logging.
requirements: Call before starting additional threads.

functions.name: cl_always_gen_section_hash
functions.signature: extern void cl_always_gen_section_hash(void);
functions.description: Force libclamav to always generate PE section hashes (used by .mdb signatures). Intended as a global scan behavior tweak.
requirements: Call before scans begin; affects engine behavior globally.

functions.name: cl_initialize_crypto
functions.signature: int cl_initialize_crypto(void);
functions.description: Initialize the OpenSSL crypto system. cl_init() calls this; OpenSSL auto-deinit handles cleanup. Returns 0 always.
requirements: May be called prior to using crypto-dependent features; otherwise cl_init() will call it.

functions.name: cl_cleanup_crypto
functions.signature: void cl_cleanup_crypto(void);
functions.description: Deprecated no-op cleanup for OpenSSL initialization. Cleanup is handled automatically in modern OpenSSL.
requirements: None; do not rely on this for resource management.

functions.name: cl_init
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_init(unsigned int initoptions);
functions.description: Initialize the ClamAV library. Sets up global state and OpenSSL. initoptions currently unused.
requirements: Call once early in process before using other libclamav APIs.
Check return value for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_engine_new
functions.signature: extern struct cl_engine *cl_engine_new(void);
functions.description: Allocate a new scanning engine with default settings. Must be freed with cl_engine_free().
requirements: Free with cl_engine_free() when finished.
Apply settings and load databases, then call cl_engine_compile() before scanning.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_num
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_engine_set_num(struct cl_engine *engine, enum cl_engine_field field, long long num);
functions.description: Set a numerical engine option (limits, toggles, etc.). Not thread-safe to change options while engine is in-use.
requirements: engine must be a valid initialized engine object.
Only call when the engine is not actively used by other threads.
Field must be a valid cl_engine_field value.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS; CL_EARG if field invalid, CL_ENULLARG on null args.

functions.name: cl_engine_get_num
functions.signature: extern long long cl_engine_get_num(const struct cl_engine *engine, enum cl_engine_field field, int *err);
functions.description: Get a numerical engine option value. Optionally returns a cl_error_t in err.
requirements: engine must be non-NULL.
If err is provided, caller should inspect it for status.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_str
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_engine_set_str(struct cl_engine *engine, enum cl_engine_field field, const char *str);
functions.description: Set a string engine option. Replaces any existing value (previous is freed internally). Not thread-safe while in-use.
requirements: engine must be a valid initialized engine.
str may be NULL only if the option allows it (unknown), otherwise provide a valid NUL-terminated string.
Only call when the engine is not in use by other threads.
Check for CL_SUCCESS; may return CL_EARG, CL_EMEM, or CL_ENULLARG.

functions.name: cl_engine_get_str
functions.signature: extern const char *cl_engine_get_str(const struct cl_engine *engine, enum cl_engine_field field, int *err);
functions.description: Get a string engine option value. Returns a pointer owned by the engine (do not free).
requirements: engine must be non-NULL.
Returned pointer is a borrowed reference; do not modify or free.
If err is provided, inspect for status.

functions.name: cl_engine_settings_copy
functions.signature: extern struct cl_settings *cl_engine_settings_copy(const struct cl_engine *engine);
functions.description: Copy current settings from an engine into a new cl_settings object. Free with cl_engine_settings_free().
requirements: engine must be a configured engine.
Free the returned settings with cl_engine_settings_free().

functions.name: cl_engine_settings_apply
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_engine_settings_apply(struct cl_engine *engine, const struct cl_settings *settings);
functions.description: Apply a cl_settings configuration to an engine. Not thread-safe while engine is in-use.
requirements: engine and settings must be non-NULL.
Only call when engine is not being used by other threads.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS; may return CL_EMEM.

functions.name: cl_engine_settings_free
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_engine_settings_free(struct cl_settings *settings);
functions.description: Free a cl_settings object allocated by cl_engine_settings_copy().
requirements: settings may be NULL only if you intend to get CL_ENULLARG; otherwise pass a valid pointer.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_engine_compile
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_engine_compile(struct cl_engine *engine);
functions.description: Prepare/compile the engine after loading databases and applying settings.
requirements: engine must be non-NULL and have databases loaded and desired settings applied.
Not thread-safe to call while engine is in use.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_engine_addref
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_engine_addref(struct cl_engine *engine);
functions.description: Increment the engine reference count to prevent premature free in multithreaded use.
requirements: engine must be non-NULL.
Use to manage shared engine lifetimes across threads.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_engine_free
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_engine_free(struct cl_engine *engine);
functions.description: Decrement the engine reference count; frees engine when it reaches zero.
requirements: engine may be NULL only if you intend to receive CL_ENULLARG; otherwise pass a valid engine.
Ensure no threads are using the engine when refcount reaches zero.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_fmap_open_handle
functions.signature: extern cl_fmap_t *cl_fmap_open_handle(void *handle, size_t offset, size_t len, clcb_pread pread_cb, int use_aging);
functions.description: Create a file map around a custom handle with a pread-like callback for scanning. Represents the entire file contents within [0,len) possibly offset within a container.
requirements: handle must be valid for the callback’s lseek+read semantics.
pread_cb must be a valid function pointer.
len must represent the entire file’s length; partial mapping may break detection.
Offset/len describe the whole file range contained in a larger file if applicable.
If use_aging != 0, fmap may discard old cached data.
Ensure size limits are acceptable before calling.

functions.name: cl_fmap_open_memory
functions.signature: extern cl_fmap_t *cl_fmap_open_memory(const void *start, size_t len);
functions.description: Create a file map backed by an in-memory buffer representing an entire file.
requirements: start must point to a readable buffer of size >= len that remains valid during scanning.
The memory must represent the complete file; partial buffers can impair detection.

functions.name: cl_fmap_set_name
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_fmap_set_name(cl_fmap_t *map, const char *name);
functions.description: Set a human-friendly UTF-8 name for a map (for logging/debugging).
requirements: map and name must be non-NULL.
Name is copied internally; caller retains ownership of input string.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_fmap_get_name
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_fmap_get_name(cl_fmap_t *map, const char **name_out);
functions.description: Get the UTF-8 name of a map for logging/debugging. Returns via name_out and may be NULL if not set.
requirements: map and name_out must be non-NULL.
Returned pointer is owned by the map; do not free.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_fmap_set_path
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_fmap_set_path(cl_fmap_t *map, const char *path);
functions.description: Associate a filesystem path with a map (for logging/debugging). Useful when map was opened via handle.
requirements: map and path must be non-NULL.
Path is copied internally; caller retains ownership of input string.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_fmap_get_path
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_fmap_get_path(cl_fmap_t *map, const char **path_out, size_t *offset_out, size_t *len_out);
functions.description: Retrieve the path and optional offset/length of the current layer backing file for a map. Path may be NULL or unavailable for handle/memory maps.
requirements: map and path_out must be non-NULL.
offset_out and len_out may be NULL if not needed.
Do not assume a non-NULL path even when a file descriptor exists.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS; CL_EACCES if no FD; CL_ENULLARG on null args.

functions.name: cl_fmap_get_fd
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_fmap_get_fd(const cl_fmap_t *map, int *fd_out, size_t *offset_out, size_t *len_out);
functions.description: Get the underlying file descriptor for a map and optional offset/length. Returns -1 if no descriptor.
requirements: map and fd_out must be non-NULL.
Caller must not close or dup the returned file descriptor.
offset_out and len_out are optional.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS; CL_EACCES if no FD; CL_ENULLARG on null args.

functions.name: cl_fmap_get_size
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_fmap_get_size(const cl_fmap_t *map, size_t *size_out);
functions.description: Get the size of the current layer represented by the map.
requirements: map and size_out must be non-NULL.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_fmap_set_hash
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_fmap_set_hash(const cl_fmap_t *map, const char *hash_alg, char hash);
functions.description: Set a precomputed file hash on the map for the given algorithm. Overwrites any previously stored hash of that type.
requirements: map and hash_alg must be non-NULL.
hash should represent the hash value, but signature uses a single char; details unclear from header (likely a string in implementation).
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_fmap_have_hash
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_fmap_have_hash(const cl_fmap_t *map, const char *hash_alg, bool *have_hash_out);
functions.description: Query whether a hash of the requested type has already been calculated/stored for the map.
requirements: map, hash_alg, and have_hash_out must be non-NULL.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_fmap_will_need_hash_later
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_fmap_will_need_hash_later(const cl_fmap_t *map, const char *hash_alg);
functions.description: Hint that a particular hash will be needed later; enables efficient co-computation with other hashing.
requirements: map and hash_alg must be non-NULL.
Call before cl_fmap_get_hash() to gain efficiency.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_fmap_get_hash
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_fmap_get_hash(const cl_fmap_t *map, const char *hash_alg, char **hash_out);
functions.description: Get or compute the file hash for the map for the requested algorithm. Returns a malloc’d NUL-terminated string that the caller must free.
requirements: map, hash_alg, and hash_out must be non-NULL.
Caller must free *hash_out with free().
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_fmap_get_data
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_fmap_get_data(const cl_fmap_t *map, size_t offset, size_t len, const uint8_t **data_out, size_t *data_len_out);
functions.description: Access a read-only pointer to data in the map from offset for up to len bytes. If len==0, provides data to end of file. Data is not malloc’d; copy if persistence is needed.
requirements: map, data_out, and data_len_out must be non-NULL.
offset must be within file size; data_len_out may be less than requested if EOF reached.
Do not free or modify returned buffer.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_fmap_close
functions.signature: extern void cl_fmap_close(cl_fmap_t *);
functions.description: Close and release resources associated with a file map.
requirements: Map must not be used after close.
Release any dependent resources you hold before calling (e.g., handles supplied to the map).

functions.name: cl_scan_layer_get_fmap
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_scan_layer_get_fmap(cl_scan_layer_t *layer, cl_fmap_t **fmap_out);
functions.description: Get the file map associated with a scan layer.
requirements: layer and fmap_out must be non-NULL.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_scan_layer_get_parent_layer
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_scan_layer_get_parent_layer(cl_scan_layer_t *layer, cl_scan_layer_t **parent_layer_out);
functions.description: Get the parent layer of a scan layer (NULL for root). Can be used to walk layer ancestry.
requirements: layer and parent_layer_out must be non-NULL.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_scan_layer_get_type
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_scan_layer_get_type(cl_scan_layer_t *layer, const char **type_out);
functions.description: Get the current file type of a scan layer. Value may change later; use FILE_TYPE callback to observe changes.
requirements: layer and type_out must be non-NULL.
Returned type string is a static reference; do not free.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_scan_layer_get_recursion_level
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_scan_layer_get_recursion_level(cl_scan_layer_t *layer, uint32_t *recursion_level_out);
functions.description: Get the recursion depth of a scan layer.
requirements: layer and recursion_level_out must be non-NULL.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_scan_layer_get_object_id
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_scan_layer_get_object_id(cl_scan_layer_t *layer, uint64_t *object_id_out);
functions.description: Get the unique object ID for a scan layer. IDs may not be dense across callbacks.
requirements: layer and object_id_out must be non-NULL.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_scan_layer_get_last_alert
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_scan_layer_get_last_alert(cl_scan_layer_t *layer, const char **alert_name_out);
functions.description: Get the last alert name for a layer (NULL if none). Do not free; copy if needed.
requirements: layer and alert_name_out must be non-NULL.
Returned pointer is owned by the engine; do not free.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_scan_layer_get_attributes
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_scan_layer_get_attributes(cl_scan_layer_t *layer, uint32_t *attributes_out);
functions.description: Get LAYER_ATTRIBUTES_* flags describing how the layer was produced (normalized, decrypted, retyped, embedded).
requirements: layer and attributes_out must be non-NULL.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_scan_callback

functions.description: Register a scan-layer callback at the specified callback location (pre-hash, pre-scan, post-scan, alert, file-type). Not thread-safe to change on in-use engine.
requirements: engine must be a valid initialized engine.
callback must be a valid function pointer.
Only set/replace before or when engine is not used by other threads.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_pre_cache
functions.signature: extern void cl_engine_set_clcb_pre_cache(struct cl_engine *engine, clcb_pre_cache callback);
functions.description: Deprecated. Set pre-cache callback (replaced by CL_SCAN_CALLBACK_PRE_HASH + cl_engine_set_scan_callback()). Not thread-safe to change on in-use engine.
requirements: engine must be valid.
callback may be NULL to clear.
Set only when engine is not in use by other threads.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_file_inspection
functions.signature: extern void cl_engine_set_clcb_file_inspection(struct cl_engine *engine, clcb_file_inspection callback);
functions.description: Deprecated/unstable interface. Set file inspection callback (superseded by CL_SCAN_CALLBACK_PRE_SCAN). Not thread-safe to change on in-use engine.
requirements: engine must be valid.
callback may be NULL to clear.
Only set when engine is not in use.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_pre_scan
functions.signature: extern void cl_engine_set_clcb_pre_scan(struct cl_engine *engine, clcb_pre_scan callback);
functions.description: Deprecated. Set pre-scan callback (superseded by CL_SCAN_CALLBACK_PRE_SCAN). Not thread-safe to change on in-use engine.
requirements: engine must be valid.
callback may be NULL to clear.
Only set when engine is not in use.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_post_scan
functions.signature: extern void cl_engine_set_clcb_post_scan(struct cl_engine *engine, clcb_post_scan callback);
functions.description: Set post-scan callback (deprecated; prefer CL_SCAN_CALLBACK_POST_SCAN via scan-layer API). Not thread-safe to change on in-use engine.
requirements: engine must be valid.
callback may be NULL to clear.
Only set when engine is not in use.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_virus_found
functions.signature: extern void cl_engine_set_clcb_virus_found(struct cl_engine *engine, clcb_virus_found callback);
functions.description: Deprecated. Set virus-found callback (cannot suppress alerts). Prefer CL_SCAN_CALLBACK_ALERT via scan-layer API. Not thread-safe to change on in-use engine.
requirements: engine must be valid.
callback may be NULL to clear.
Only set when engine is not in use.

functions.signature: extern void cl_engine_set_clcb_sigload(struct cl_engine *engine, clcb_sigload callback, void *context);
functions.description: Set signature-load callback to optionally skip signatures at DB load time. Not thread-safe to change on in-use engine.
requirements: engine must be valid.
callback must be valid; ensure dependencies between signatures are preserved (skipping dependencies may fail DB load).
Only set/replace when engine is not in use.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_sigload_progress
functions.signature: extern void cl_engine_set_clcb_sigload_progress(struct cl_engine *engine, clcb_progress callback, void *context);
functions.description: Register a progress callback for database load operations. Not thread-safe to change on in-use engine.
requirements: engine must be valid.
callback must be valid.
Only set when engine is not in use.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_engine_compile_progress
functions.signature: extern void cl_engine_set_clcb_engine_compile_progress(struct cl_engine *engine, clcb_progress callback, void *context);
functions.description: Register a progress callback for engine compile. Not thread-safe to change on in-use engine.
requirements: engine must be valid.
callback must be valid.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_stats_decrement_count
functions.signature: extern void cl_engine_set_clcb_stats_decrement_count(struct cl_engine *engine, clcb_stats_decrement_count callback);

functions.signature: extern void cl_engine_set_clcb_stats_submit(struct cl_engine *engine, clcb_stats_submit callback);

functions.signature: extern void cl_engine_set_clcb_stats_get_num(struct cl_engine *engine, clcb_stats_get_num callback);

requirements: engine must be valid.
callback must be valid.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_stats_get_size

functions.signature: extern void cl_engine_set_clcb_stats_get_hostid(struct cl_engine *engine, clcb_stats_get_hostid callback);

functions.name: cl_scandesc
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_scandesc(int desc, const char *filename, const char **virname, unsigned long int *scanned, const struct cl_engine *engine, struct cl_scan_options *scanoptions);
functions.description: Deprecated. Scan an open file descriptor with optional filename. Returns CL_SUCCESS, CL_VIRUS, or error; virname is static if infected. scanned is bytes_scanned/CL_COUNT_PRECISION.
requirements: desc must be a valid open file descriptor readable by the process.
engine must be initialized, databases loaded, and compiled via cl_engine_compile().
scanoptions must be a valid struct.
virname and scanned pointers must be valid if provided.

functions.name: cl_scandesc_callback
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_scandesc_callback(int desc, const char *filename, const char **virname, unsigned long int *scanned, const struct cl_engine *engine, struct cl_scan_options *scanoptions, void *context);
functions.description: Deprecated. As cl_scandesc but allows an application-defined context used by callbacks.
requirements: Same as cl_scandesc; plus context is optional and opaque to libclamav.

functions.name: cl_scandesc_ex
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_scandesc_ex(int desc, const char *filename, cl_verdict_t *verdict_out, const char **last_alert_out, uint64_t *scanned_out, const struct cl_engine *engine, struct cl_scan_options *scanoptions, void *context, const char *hash_hint, char **hash_out, const char *hash_alg, const char *file_type_hint, char **file_type_out);
functions.description: Scan a file descriptor with extended outputs/hints. Produces a verdict (not via return), the last alert (static string), exact scanned byte count, optional hash (malloc’d), and top-layer file type (malloc’d).
requirements: desc must be a valid open file descriptor.
engine must be initialized, DBs loaded, and compiled.
scanoptions must be valid.
verdict_out and scanned_out must be non-NULL.
If hash_out is non-NULL and used, caller must free *hash_out.
If file_type_out is non-NULL and set, caller must free *file_type_out.
hash_hint may be NULL; if provided, hash_alg should match the hint.
last_alert_out may be NULL; if used, do not free returned pointer.

functions.name: cl_scanfile
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_scanfile(const char *filename, const char **virname, unsigned long int *scanned, const struct cl_engine *engine, struct cl_scan_options *scanoptions);
functions.description: Deprecated. Scan a file by path. Returns CL_SUCCESS, CL_VIRUS, or error; virname is static if infected. scanned is bytes_scanned/CL_COUNT_PRECISION.
requirements: filename must reference a readable file.
engine must be initialized, databases loaded, and compiled.
scanoptions must be valid.
virname and scanned pointers must be valid if provided.

functions.name: cl_scanfile_callback
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_scanfile_callback(const char *filename, const char **virname, unsigned long int *scanned, const struct cl_engine *engine, struct cl_scan_options *scanoptions, void *context);
functions.description: Deprecated. As cl_scanfile but allows application-defined context for callbacks.
requirements: Same as cl_scanfile; context optional.

functions.name: cl_scanfile_ex
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_scanfile_ex(const char *filename, cl_verdict_t *verdict_out, const char **last_alert_out, uint64_t *scanned_out, const struct cl_engine *engine, struct cl_scan_options *scanoptions, void *context, const char *hash_hint, char **hash_out, const char *hash_alg, const char *file_type_hint, char **file_type_out);
functions.description: Scan a file by path with extended outputs/hints. Produces verdict, last alert (static), scanned bytes, optional hash (malloc’d), and determined top-layer file type (malloc’d).
requirements: filename must be a readable file path.
engine must be initialized, DBs loaded, and compiled.
scanoptions must be valid.
verdict_out and scanned_out must be non-NULL.
If hash_out is set, caller must free *hash_out.
If file_type_out is set, caller must free *file_type_out.
hash_hint/file_type_hint optional; ignored if unrecognized.
Do not free last_alert_out value.

functions.name: cl_scanmap_callback
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_scanmap_callback(cl_fmap_t *map, const char *filename, const char **virname, unsigned long int *scanned, const struct cl_engine *engine, struct cl_scan_options *scanoptions, void *context);
functions.description: Deprecated. Scan custom data via a file map with optional name and context. Returns CL_SUCCESS, CL_VIRUS, or error. scanned is bytes_scanned/CL_COUNT_PRECISION.
requirements: map must be a valid cl_fmap_t created by cl_fmap_open_*().
engine must be initialized, DBs loaded, and compiled.
scanoptions must be valid.
virname and scanned pointers valid if provided.

functions.name: cl_scanmap_ex
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_scanmap_ex(cl_fmap_t *map, const char *filename, cl_verdict_t *verdict_out, const char **last_alert_out, uint64_t *scanned_out, const struct cl_engine *engine, struct cl_scan_options *scanoptions, void *context, const char *hash_hint, char **hash_out, const char *hash_alg, const char *file_type_hint, char **file_type_out);
functions.description: Scan a file map with extended outputs/hints. Produces verdict, last alert (static), exact scanned bytes, optional hash (malloc’d), and top-layer file type (malloc’d).
requirements: map must be a valid cl_fmap_t.
engine must be initialized, DBs loaded, and compiled.
scanoptions must be valid.
verdict_out and scanned_out must be non-NULL.
If hash_out is set, caller must free *hash_out.
If file_type_out is set, caller must free *file_type_out.
hash_hint/file_type_hint optional; may be ignored.
Do not free last_alert_out value.

functions.name: cl_load
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_load(const char *path, struct cl_engine *engine, unsigned int *signo, unsigned int dboptions);
functions.description: Load signature databases from a file or directory into an engine. Returns number of signatures loaded in signo.

engine must be a valid engine.
signo must be a valid pointer if provided to receive count.
dboptions bitmask must use CL_DB_* flags.
Compile engine afterwards with cl_engine_compile().

functions.name: cl_retdbdir
functions.signature: extern const char *cl_retdbdir(void);
functions.description: Return the default database directory path.
requirements: Returned pointer is static/const; do not free.

functions.name: cl_cvdhead
functions.signature: extern struct cl_cvd *cl_cvdhead(const char *file);
functions.description: Read and parse a CVD file header from disk. Returns allocated struct; free with cl_cvdfree().
requirements: file must be a readable CVD file path.
Caller must free the returned struct with cl_cvdfree().

functions.name: cl_cvdparse
functions.signature: extern struct cl_cvd *cl_cvdparse(const char *head);
functions.description: Parse a CVD header from a header buffer (length checks are expected by caller of cl_cvdhead()). Returns allocated struct; free with cl_cvdfree().
requirements: head must point to a valid CVD header string/buffer.
Caller must free the returned struct with cl_cvdfree().

functions.name: cl_cvdverify
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_cvdverify(const char *file);
functions.description: Deprecated. Verify a CVD file by loading/unloading it.
requirements: file must be a readable CVD file path.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS or specific error.

functions.name: cl_cvdverify_ex
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_cvdverify_ex(const char *file, const char *certs_directory, uint32_t dboptions);
functions.description: Verify a CVD file (optionally verify digital signature). Supports FIPS/signature verification options via dboptions.

Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_cvdfree
functions.signature: extern void cl_cvdfree(struct cl_cvd *cvd);
functions.description: Free a struct cl_cvd allocated by cl_cvdhead() or cl_cvdparse().
requirements: cvd must be a pointer returned by cl_cvdhead()/cl_cvdparse().

functions.name: cl_cvdunpack
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_cvdunpack(const char *file, const char *dir, bool dont_verify);
functions.description: Deprecated. Unpack a CVD file to a directory. Will verify signature unless dont_verify is true.
requirements: file must be a readable CVD file path.
dir must be a writable destination directory.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_cvdunpack_ex
functions.signature: cl_error_t cl_cvdunpack_ex(const char *file, const char *dir, const char *certs_directory, uint32_t dboptions);
functions.description: Unpack a CVD file to a directory with optional signature verification controls and certs directory.
requirements: file must be a readable CVD/CLD file path.
dir must be a writable destination directory.
certs_directory required to verify external signatures.
dboptions may include CL_DB_FIPS_LIMITS and/or CL_DB_UNSIGNED.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_cvdgetage
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_cvdgetage(const char *path, time_t *age_seconds);
functions.description: Get age (seconds) of youngest file in a database directory or of a single CVD/CLD file.
requirements: path must be a readable file or directory.
age_seconds must be non-NULL.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_statinidir
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_statinidir(const char *dirname, struct cl_stat *dbstat);
functions.description: Initialize watching a database directory for changes. Allocates internal state within dbstat; free with cl_statfree().
requirements: dirname must exist and be readable.

Call cl_statfree() to free resources.

functions.name: cl_statchkdir
functions.signature: extern int cl_statchkdir(const struct cl_stat *dbstat);
functions.description: Check watched database directory for changes. Returns 0 if no change, 1 if some change occurred.
requirements: dbstat must be a valid initialized handle from cl_statinidir().

functions.name: cl_statfree
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_statfree(struct cl_stat *dbstat);
functions.description: Free resources allocated for cl_stat watch handle.
requirements: dbstat must have been initialized via cl_statinidir().
Check return for CL_SUCCESS; CL_ENULLARG on null.

functions.name: cl_countsigs
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_countsigs(const char *path, unsigned int countoptions, unsigned int *sigs);
functions.description: Count signatures in a database file or directory. Use CL_COUNTSIGS_* flags to select official/custom.
requirements: path must be a readable db file/directory.
sigs must be non-NULL to receive count.
countoptions must be a valid combination (CL_COUNTSIGS_OFFICIAL/UNOFFICIAL/ALL).

functions.name: cl_retflevel
functions.signature: extern unsigned int cl_retflevel(void);
functions.description: Return the Functionality Level (FLEVEL) supported by this libclamav build.
requirements: Return is a value; no cleanup required.

functions.name: cl_retver
functions.signature: extern const char *cl_retver(void);
functions.description: Return the ClamAV version string (e.g., "clamav-..." ).
requirements: Returned string is static; do not free.

functions.name: cl_strerror
functions.signature: extern const char *cl_strerror(cl_error_t clerror);
functions.description: Return a human-readable string for a cl_error_t code.
requirements: Input must be a valid cl_error_t value.
Returned string is static; do not free.

functions.name: cl_hash_data_ex
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_hash_data_ex(const char *alg, const uint8_t *data, size_t data_len, uint8_t **hash, size_t *hash_len, uint32_t flags);
functions.description: Hash arbitrary data using OpenSSL EVP. Supports allocation via CL_HASH_FLAG_ALLOCATE and FIPS bypass via CL_HASH_FLAG_FIPS_BYPASS.
requirements: alg must name a supported algorithm (e.g., "md5","sha1","sha2-256","sha2-384","sha2-512").
data and hash must be non-NULL.
If not allocating, caller must supply a buffer and set *hash_len to its size (however API always returns via **hash; flags govern allocation).
If CL_HASH_FLAG_ALLOCATE is used, caller must free *hash with free().
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_hash_init_ex
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_hash_init_ex(const char *alg, uint32_t flags, cl_hash_ctx_t **ctx_out);
functions.description: Initialize a streaming hash context with optional FIPS bypass.
requirements: alg must be supported.
ctx_out must be non-NULL; on success *ctx_out must later be destroyed with cl_hash_destroy_ex().
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_update_hash_ex
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_update_hash_ex(cl_hash_ctx_t *ctx, const uint8_t *data, size_t length);
functions.description: Update a streaming hash context with more data.
requirements: ctx must be a valid context from cl_hash_init_ex().
data may be NULL only if length==0 (unknown).
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_finish_hash_ex
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_finish_hash_ex(cl_hash_ctx_t *ctx, uint8_t **hash, size_t *hash_len, uint32_t flags);
functions.description: Finalize a streaming hash and output digest. Can allocate output with CL_HASH_FLAG_ALLOCATE.
requirements: ctx must be a valid context.
hash and hash_len must be non-NULL.
If CL_HASH_FLAG_ALLOCATE is set, caller must free *hash with free().
After finalization, destroy ctx with cl_hash_destroy_ex().
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_hash_destroy_ex
functions.signature: extern void cl_hash_destroy_ex(cl_hash_ctx_t *ctx);
functions.description: Destroy a hash context created with cl_hash_init_ex().
requirements: Do not use ctx after destruction.

functions.name: cl_hash_file_fd_ex
functions.signature: extern cl_error_t cl_hash_file_fd_ex(const char *alg, int fd, size_t offset, size_t length, uint8_t **hash, size_t *hash_len, uint32_t flags);
functions.description: Hash a file region given a file descriptor, with optional allocation and FIPS bypass. If length==0, hash to EOF.
requirements: alg must be supported.
fd must be a valid readable file descriptor.
hash and hash_len must be non-NULL.
If CL_HASH_FLAG_ALLOCATE is set, caller must free *hash with free().
offset must be within file size; length may be 0 for whole file.
Check return for CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_hash_data
functions.signature: extern unsigned char *cl_hash_data(const char *alg, const void *buf, size_t len, unsigned char *obuf, unsigned int *olen);
functions.description: Deprecated convenience hashing function that bypasses FIPS restrictions. Prefer cl_hash_data_ex().
requirements: alg must be supported by OpenSSL EVP.
If obuf is NULL, returned pointer must be freed with free(). If obuf is provided, ensure buffer is large enough for selected hash and returned pointer equals obuf.
olen may be non-NULL to receive digest length.

functions.name: cl_hash_file_fd_ctx
functions.signature: extern unsigned char *cl_hash_file_fd_ctx(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, int fd, unsigned int *olen);
functions.description: Deprecated. Hash a file using a caller-supplied OpenSSL EVP_MD_CTX. Returns malloc’d digest.
requirements: ctx must be a valid OpenSSL EVP_MD_CTX prepared with a digest algorithm.
fd must be a valid readable file descriptor.
Caller must free the returned buffer.
olen optional to receive length.

functions.name: cl_hash_file_fd
functions.signature: extern unsigned char *cl_hash_file_fd(int fd, const char *alg, unsigned int *olen);
functions.description: Deprecated. Hash a file by descriptor; bypasses FIPS restrictions. Prefer cl_hash_file_fd_ex().
requirements: fd must be valid and readable.
alg must be supported.

olen optional to receive length.

functions.name: cl_hash_file_fp
functions.signature: extern unsigned char *cl_hash_file_fp(FILE *fp, const char *alg, unsigned int *olen);
functions.description: Deprecated. Hash a file by FILE*; bypasses FIPS restrictions. Prefer cl_hash_file_fd_ex().
requirements: fp must be a valid readable FILE*.
alg must be supported.
Caller must free returned buffer.
olen optional to receive length.

functions.name: cl_sha256
functions.signature: extern unsigned char *cl_sha256(const void *buf, size_t len, unsigned char *obuf, unsigned int *olen);
functions.description: Deprecated. Hash data with SHA-256. Prefer cl_hash_data_ex().
requirements: If obuf is NULL, caller must free returned buffer; otherwise obuf must be large enough (SHA256_HASH_SIZE).
olen optional to receive length.

functions.name: cl_sha384
functions.signature: extern unsigned char *cl_sha384(const void *buf, size_t len, unsigned char *obuf, unsigned int *olen);
functions.description: Deprecated. Hash data with SHA-384. Prefer cl_hash_data_ex().
requirements: If obuf is NULL, caller must free returned buffer; otherwise obuf must be large enough (SHA384_HASH_SIZE).
olen optional to receive length.

functions.name: cl_sha512
functions.signature: extern unsigned char *cl_sha512(const void *buf, size_t len, unsigned char *obuf, unsigned int *olen);
functions.description: Deprecated. Hash data with SHA-512. Prefer cl_hash_data_ex().
requirements: If obuf is NULL, caller must free returned buffer; otherwise obuf must be large enough (SHA512_HASH_SIZE).
olen optional to receive length.

functions.name: cl_sha1
functions.signature: extern unsigned char *cl_sha1(const void *buf, size_t len, unsigned char *obuf, unsigned int *olen);
functions.description: Deprecated. Hash data with SHA-1 (bypasses FIPS). Prefer cl_hash_data_ex().
requirements: If obuf is NULL, caller must free returned buffer; otherwise obuf must be large enough (SHA1_HASH_SIZE).
olen optional to receive length.

functions.name: cl_hash_init
functions.signature: extern void *cl_hash_init(const char *alg);
functions.description: Deprecated. Initialize a hashing context (bypasses FIPS). Prefer cl_hash_init_ex(). Returns an opaque context pointer.

functions.name: cl_update_hash
functions.signature: extern int cl_update_hash(void *ctx, const void *data, size_t sz);

requirements: ctx must be from cl_hash_init().

functions.name: cl_finish_hash
functions.signature: extern int cl_finish_hash(void *ctx, void *buf);

requirements: ctx from cl_hash_init().
buf must be large enough for the selected algorithm.

functions.name: cl_hash_destroy
functions.signature: extern void cl_hash_destroy(void *ctx);

requirements: Do not use ctx after destroy.

fd must be a valid readable file descriptor.
alg must name the hash algorithm.
sig/siglen are the signature.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on error/invalid.

alg must match digest algorithm.

requirements: x509path must be a readable X509 path with public key.
fd must be valid and readable.
alg must be supported.
